scope_exception: Authorize graceful cancellation of the exact root-owned Nix worker despite its original task ownership remaining unproved
process_action: Operator-issued SIGTERM only, after fresh exact process and lock validation
known_risk: Cancels the worker's pending Nix store operation; task ownership is not proved

constraints: Do not signal main daemon PID 2631 or other workers

No host configuration change or GC override
No acceptance weakening or premature lifecycle closeout
